examples.arabic: لما فتح سامي الكيس، لقى بين حبات الطحين مفتاح مصدي ورسالة قديمة مكتوبة بخط إيد بيعرفه كتير منيح.
examples.english: When Sami opened the bag, he found among the grains of flour a rusty key and an old letter written in a handwriting he knew very well.
examples.transliteration: Lamma fataH Sami al-kis, la'a bayn habbat al-tHin miftah mSaddi wa-risala qadima maktouba bi-khatt id bi-ya'rifo ktir mniH.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: انصدم رامي، صاحب القهوة العصبي اللي عمرو خمسة وتلاتين سنة، لما فتح خزانته بشارع الحمرا واكتشف إنو عمال التوصيل ما جابوا كياس البن.
examples.english: Rami, the stressed thirty-five-year-old coffee shop owner, was shocked when he opened his cabinet on Hamra street and discovered that the delivery workers did not bring the bags of coffee beans.
examples.transliteration: Insadam Rami, saheb el ahwe el asabi elli amro khamse w tlatin sene, lamma fatah khazanto bi sharee el Hamra w iktashaf inno ommal el tawsil ma jabu kiyas el bon.

examples.arabic: اول ما فتح الباب قلتله مساء الخير كيفكَ
examples.english: As soon as he opened the door, I said to him 'Good evening, how are you?'
examples.transliteration: Awwal ma fataḥ al-bāb qultillo masāʾ al-khayr kayfak

examples.english: He opened the window and heard the sound of birds.
examples.transliteration: fataḥ esh-shubbak w sima' sowt el 'asaafeer.
